manual.circuit_breakers.line2: {0}Breaker Switches are simple switches that can stop the flow of power through wires.{1}
manual.circuit_breakers.line3: They connect two wires of the same type and will only allow power to pass when activated. Due to the high risk, these switches cannot be connected to HV wiring.{0}
manual.circuit_breakers.line4: This can be used to separate power-hungry machinery from the network or hook up an additional set of generators when needed.{0}
manual.circuit_breakers.line5: They will also emit a redstone signal when they are switched on; this behaviour can be inverted by clicking the switch with an Engineer's Screwdriver.{0}
manual.circuit_breakers.line6: Additionally they are an excellent way to control your {0}powered lights{1}!
manual.circuit_breakers.line7: {0}Redstone Breakers are an all-around improved version of the manual Breaker Switch, with improved wiring, throughput, and isolation.{1}
manual.circuit_breakers.line8: Redstone Breakers are able to handle HV wiring, unlike their manual counterparts, but cannot be operated by hand due to the safety risk.{0}
manual.circuit_breakers.line9: A redstone signal applied to any side of the device will break the connection. This behavior can be inverted with the Engineers' Screwdriver.
